reuse_without_duplication: existing wavesurfer-based player and transcribe pipeline
goals: Deliver stable long transcript flow for 30-240 minute sources
Add compact segment slicer in /library with preset windows and max 21 manual points
Implement pause-aware boundary snapping with configurable tolerance
Run segmented transcript as one logical job row in /transcript
Validate stability on at least three Czech models

Large UI redesign outside slicer/transcript integration
Adding brand-new STT adapters before long-run gate passes
